cohort: Very-low-birth weight (VLBW) infants with gestational age (GA) <32 weeks or birth weight <1500 g admitted to the neonatal unit of a tertiary care hospital between January 1, 2011, and December 31, 2021.
finding: Conception achieved via assisted conception (AC) or in vitro fertilization (IVF) was not significantly associated with retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) in any degree of severity.
